hints.title: Problem Analysis
hints.text: A polygon of k sides requires that the longest side is strictly smaller than the sum of all other k - 1 sides.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Sort the array in ascending order.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy
hints.text: Maintain a running prefix sum of side lengths. A valid candidate exists at index i (i >= 2) if nums[i] < prefix[i].
